newsitem.title: USA: InterCel sells Maine unit for $77 mln.
newsitem.headline: InterCel sells Maine unit for $77 mln.

text.p: InterCel Inc said Friday it has completed the sale of its Maine cellular subsidiary, Unity Cellular Systems Inc, to Rural Cellular Corp for $77 million in cash.
The company said that it intends to redeploy the funds to its continuing buildout of its large contiguous PCS footprint in the southeastern U.S.

InterCel owns and operates cellular telephone systems in western Georgia and eastern Alabama, and through a subsidiary, is licensed (or has licenses pending) to provide PCS in cities includiong Atlanta, Augusta, Birmingham, Chattanooga, Jackson, Jacksonville, Knoxville, Louisville, Memphis and Nashville.
